game-file-confirmed-label.meaning: Readable UI/localization label extracted from the uploaded The Tower v28.1.0 XAPK.
game-file-confirmed-label.notSafeUse: Do not infer formulas from wording alone.

game-file-observed.meaning: BattleHistoryEntry/metadata field name observed in Unity/IL2CPP metadata from the uploaded v28.1.0 XAPK.
game-file-observed.safeUse: Use as schema, parser, grouping, and debug clue.
game-file-observed.notSafeUse: Do not claim exact numeric formulas or all hidden source inclusions.

game-file-observed-medium-high.meaning: Observed field mapping plus nearby Battle Report/stat naming gives a strong practical interpretation, but no full formula body was extracted.
game-file-observed-medium-high.safeUse: Use for TBI explanations with a confidence label.
game-file-observed-medium-high.notSafeUse: Do not list every exact included sub-source unless separately confirmed.

community-or-google.meaning: External web/community info, not taken from the uploaded game file.
community-or-google.safeUse: Use as guidance with visible source confidence.
community-or-google.notSafeUse: Do not treat as official baseline.

tbi-inferred.meaning: Derived by Tower Battle Intel from parsed reports, trends, and heuristics.
tbi-inferred.safeUse: Use for recommendations and analysis, clearly labelled.

manual-user-tag.meaning: A tag Andrew manually applies, such as Tournament, sample report, or Dissonance context.
manual-user-tag.safeUse: Use for saved report filtering/comparison when the pasted report does not include official internal flags.
manual-user-tag.notSafeUse: Do not assume all real exports include Andrew’s manual marker text.
